link_preview.title: Bass OS (A14) AIO - Setting up VNC and remoting into your Android device
link_preview.description_html:
In this short video, I show how to set up a secure VNC connection to Android and remote into it through the web.

We contribute back to the OSS we use in our projects:
- Installer is based off Bliss OS' bootable_aaropa
- Android 14 source is also from Bliss…
